newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money rates steady, SNB not seen in market.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money rates steady, SNB not seen in market.

text.p: Swiss short-term money market rates were steady with tommorow/next quoted slightly below 1.50 percent. Dealers expect rates to stabilise around this level during the rest of this year.
The Swiss National Bank (SNB) was not seen in the market.

The rise in sight deposits to 3.8 billion Swiss francs announced yesterday showed the SNB was still following its strategy of adding liquidity to the market to keep the franc easy and stimulate the economy, dealers said. They expect short-term rates to ease further next year once banks' needs for year-end funds passes. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
